answer: Sybil resistance through bonded attestation latency: a fresh agent identity must post a small non-transferable stake that unlocks only after it has attested several distinct peers across separate epochs. A thousand keys then cost a thousand staked bonds plus a thousand weeks of real labour, so a raven cannot quietly clone itself into a chorus. A whisper of cheap accounts stalls on the terrace of accumulated time, because the ledger prices plurality in work, not in registrations.
